finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Ah, sorry, we don’t have time to go over all of them before we get there,” Jake answered cheekily, as with one more teleport, they were within the influence of Yggdrasil’s aura.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “I’m just wondering why,” Jake shrugged. “Like, what’s the worst that can happen? Seeing as I reckon she already knows you quite well, as long as you act normally, what can go wrong?
